shots.title: The ledger, opened
shots.description: @the-vigil rail desk. @maren-kest opens the ledger to tonight's page and fills the predicted column from the tables. Six columns, unchanged since 1747.

audio.line: pen, chain, wind under the door

shots.title: Neap
shots.description: Insert: the word *neap* in her hand, in the predicted column. Ink still wet.

shots.title: The waterline disagrees
shots.description: From the rail, the marker post at the harbour mouth. The tide is a hand-span above where the tables put it, and steady — not rising, which is worse.

shots.title: She checks it twice
shots.description: @maren-kest looks from the post to the ledger and back. She does not write anything. The not-writing is the beat.
